name: My puppy: Shepherd
summary: Meet your brave and loyal German Shepherd in mixed reality! Smart, strong, and protective, this companion is always ready to play or stand by your side. Feed it crunchy biscuits and juicy chicken legs to reward its loyalty. Toss a ball or toy bone to spark its playful energy, and watch it sprint with precision and excitement.
